title: Woman at Petrified Forest, 1950s Snapshot, B&W, Arizona
location: Petrified Forest National Park, Arizona, USA
description: A black and white snapshot from around the 1950s featuring an elderly woman posing beside large petrified wood logs in a dry desert terrain, likely Petrified Forest National Park in Arizona.
